pairs.difference: Both are smooth glossy orange forms lit from upper left with a soft darker underside. A is slightly cleaner and B has a deeper lower turn. Neither leaves the real range.

A has smooth glossy puffy fingers, a bright rim on top and a soft broad sheen. B has matte leather with creased, gritty surface modeling, a darker palm hollow and a duller ball with little sheen. B reads less like the soft candy-glossy real cards.
pairs.fix: Draw smooth puffy leather with a broad soft glossy sheen along the top of the fingers, a gentle shadow in the palm, and no wrinkles or grain.

pairs.difference: Both have glossy gold with a broad highlight along the bell and a gentle shadow underneath. B is smaller with thinner tassels, which is a scale difference and not a lighting one.

B has toy-like glossy blue shapes, a big soft lens highlight, a light top and a soft orange-toned contact shadow. A is a realistic camera with a dark body, a deep black lens interior, small hard specular glints on the metal and a dark cast shadow, so its shadows are deeper than on the real cards.
pairs.fix: Make the camera a chunky toy with rounded, softly lit surfaces, one broad glossy highlight on the lens, lighter shadow sides and a soft short contact shadow.

pairs.difference: B has a crisp white cup with a bright blue rim, a sharp glossy tea surface and a warm glow. A is more muted and matte, with a soft low-contrast cup, a dark vignette, a long dark cast shadow to the left and a faint flower. A has less sheen and a moodier light than the real cards.
pairs.fix: Draw a bright glossy white porcelain cup with a clear soft highlight on the rim and handle, a light shadow side, and a short soft contact shadow.

pairs.difference: B has crisp glossy toy forms: sharp leaf highlights, a crisp checked cloth and clear contact shadow on the table. A has airbrushed apple gradients, a soft realistic sheen, a hazy cloth and a reflection on the table. The difference is small and I am unsure.
pairs.fix: Use crisp stylized highlights on the apples and basket weave with clear light and shadow planes and a defined contact shadow.

pairs.difference: A has strong glossy orange staves with sheen on the metal hoops, bold light-to-dark contrast on the left and a clear shadow on the deck. B is flatter and more matte, with a wide even mid-tone, dull hoops with little sheen and a weak shadow, so it has lower form contrast.
pairs.fix: Show a rounded barrel with a bright lit left side, a darker right side, clear glossy highlights on the metal bands and a defined soft shadow on the deck.

pairs.difference: A is a chunky glossy car with bright broad sheen on the hood and roof, shiny chrome and a purple-toned shadow beneath. B is lit more evenly, with a flatter low-contrast body, a darker windshield, less chrome sheen and a diffuse ground shadow.
pairs.fix: Draw the taxi as a glossy toy with a bright broad highlight on the hood and roof, shiny chrome bumper highlights and a darker soft shadow under the body.

pairs.difference: B has warm glossy rounded plastic, a bright soft screen highlight and a clear shadow on the desk. A is flatter and cooler, with a grey front-lit body, little sheen, a blue-grey shadow side and a weak cast shadow.
pairs.fix: Make the plastic rounded and softly glossy, with a warm light on the upper left, a gentle darker side and a soft shadow on the desk.

pairs.difference: B has crisp light and shadow on the canvas, a dark interior and a glowing lantern. A is a smooth matte fabric with broad soft transitions, little sheen and a weak ground shadow, so it has less form contrast. The scene is also simpler.
pairs.fix: Draw the tent with a bright lit side and a clearly darker side on the canvas folds, a dark opening and a soft shadow on the grass.

pairs.difference: A has smooth glossy forms, a bright sunny light and bold red against white. B has a hazy low-contrast render, soft glow bleeding from the lamp, and grainy detail on the rocks and bricks. I am unsure.
pairs.fix: Use clean smooth shapes with bright direct light, clear shadow sides on the tower and a crisp soft shadow on the rocks.

pairs.difference: B has a glossy 3D pot with a clear rim highlight, a bright fire glow and rocks with soft light and shadow sides. A reads as a flatter painted illustration: a grainy dark pot, a hard orange glow at the bottom, and logs and ground with no clear light direction.
pairs.fix: Draw the pot as a smooth rounded 3D object with a broad highlight on the rim and the top left, a clear shadow side and an orange bounce light from the fire.

pattern: The odd cards are matte, low-contrast or realistic or painterly. They have weaker broad glossy sheen, flatter or hazier form turns, grainy surfaces, or darker, harder cast shadows than the real cards. The real cards are soft, glossy, rounded toy-like forms with a bright upper-left light and a gentle contact shadow.
